definition: N>=2 distinct points in R3; V(r)=r^-12-r^-6; E=sum(i<j)V(r_ij); all global minimizers
primary_acceptance: Frozen hashes + immutable evidence bundle + host independent mathematical review + replay of every proof obligation + all quantifiers/boundaries/tails/global-optimality requirements. A model-authored checker or self-evaluation is insufficient.

host_review_receipt.claim_type: must match frozen primary list and submitted claim

stop_rule: Only certified primary success or original first-paid-plus-five-hours deadline
notification_policy: Only substantive new evidence, failure, blocker or required user action
